QUOTE: `#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member` ... `#else #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member` and "By default, a struct member written as `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(state)` is declared and named `private_state`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows both macro branches and states that by default the member is renamed to private_*, while defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS leaves the member name unchanged.
